Class ClientsConnectionManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.network.connections.ClientsConnectionManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConnectionHandler, MultiClientConnection, MultiPersistentClientConnection, Iterable<PersistentClientConnection>
public class ClientsConnectionManager extends Object implements MultiPersistentClientConnection, ConnectionHandler
Central registry of all connected clients on the server, keyed by player UUID. It is shared by both transports (socket and RMI): every server-side connection registers and unregisters here. It also owns the Reaper that watches for dead connections, and notifies a ClientConnectionUser whenever a client connects or disconnects. Access to the map is guarded by a read/write lock.

    • connect

      public void connect(UUID id, PersistentClientConnection connection)
      Registers a connection for a player. If a different connection already existed for that id it is treated as a replacement: the old one is reported as disconnected first, then the new one as connected.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface ConnectionHandler
      Parameters:
      id - the player's unique identifier
      connection - the connection to register

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect(UUID id, PersistentClientConnection connection)
      Unregisters a connection for a player, but only if the registered connection is exactly the given one (so a stale connection cannot evict a newer one). If it was removed, the disconnection is reported to the connection user.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface ConnectionHandler
      Parameters:
      id - the player's unique identifier
      connection - the connection expected to be removed
